# Can semantic consistency training improve behavior prediction robustness?

2026-11-26 | Anicca Research

**TL;DR.** We ran 16 actual optimizer steps and reloaded four adapters. Base AUC 0.5882/0.6199/0.6184, range 0.0055, order gap 0.1372; Augmentation AUC 0.5935/0.6282/0.6146, range 0.0058, order gap 0.0677; Joint consistency AUC 0.5875/0.6184/0.6101, range 0.0063, order gap 0.0575. No promotion.

![cover](/assets/research/manager-execution-06-semantic-training-2026-11-26-cover.svg)

Cover: Run06, test64 (13 positive).

## The problem
Run05 found substantial wording sensitivity. We tested a matched augmentation versus joint regularization comparison, for ML engineers familiar with LoRA and binary classification.

## How we did it
Matched weighted binary SFT; 32 training (5 positive), 32 calibration (7 positive), 64 test (13 positive); two seeds, 4 steps per arm. Three question templates and both option orders per training example. Joint adds lambda=5 each for permutation and semantic MSE. Test includes original and two held-out questions; context and option labels stay English. All four saved adapters reloaded, maximum calibrated prediction delta zero. Canonical calibrator transferred to unseen questions. Own-pilot split only, no formal translation adjudication. Both regularizers added jointly; no component isolation or canonical-only trained control.

![pipeline](/assets/research/manager-execution-06-semantic-training-2026-11-26-pipeline.svg)

Figure 1. Matched training and independent question wording evaluation.

## Results

| Model | Original AUC | Held EN AUC | Held JA AUC | Raw range | Mean order gap |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Base | 0.58824 | 0.61991 | 0.61840 | 0.00553 | 0.13724 |
| Augmentation | 0.59351 | 0.62821 | 0.61463 | 0.00585 | 0.06772 |
| Joint consistency | 0.58748 | 0.61840 | 0.61011 | 0.00626 | 0.05747 |

![chart](/assets/research/manager-execution-06-semantic-training-2026-11-26-chart.svg)

Figure 2. Actual held-question AUROC and raw probability range, same 64 sessions. [Receipt and audit](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca/pull/9520). Independent AUROC/Brier verification and 2,000 paired stratified bootstrap draws per seed.

## Trade-offs and limitations
We chose a small CPU test, two seeds and four optimizer steps. Both penalties are added together; no canonical-only trained arm. Questions are manually authored, no independent translation adjudication. Context and options stay English. Test is retrospective and own-pilot disjoint only; global overlap unknown. No official benchmark, prospective prediction or causal benefit established.

## Reproduce or contribute
[Code, weights and predictions](https://github.com/Daisuke134/anicca/pull/9520); propose independent templates and a larger factorial ablation.
